lignes.zh: 他送了女朋友一束玫瑰。
lignes.pinyin: tā sòng le nǚ péng you yī shù méi gui
lignes.fr: Il a offert un bouquet de roses à sa petite amie.
lignes.en: He gave his girlfriend a bunch of roses.

lignes.pinyin: huā li hái fàng zhe yī méi jiè zhi
lignes.fr: Au milieu des fleurs, une bague.
lignes.en: Among the flowers there was a ring.

lignes.pinyin: tā gǎn dòng de kū le
lignes.en: She was so moved that she cried.
